name: Chuyển mạch công nghiệp PoE 8 cổng 1000Mb, 4 cổng SFP+ 10G
summary: Switch công nghiệp Gigabit Ethernet PoE quản lý được với 8 cổng PoE 10/100/1000BASE-TX và 4 cổng uplink quang 10G SFP+, hỗ trợ PoE IEEE 802.3bt/at/af lên đến 90W mỗi cổng (tổng 480 W). Thiết kế DIN-Rail vỏ kim loại IP50, nhiệt độ hoạt động -40 ~ 75 ˚C.
features: 8 cổng PoE 10/100/1000BASE-TX và 4 cổng uplink quang 10G SFP+
PoE chuẩn IEEE 802.3bt/at/af, lên đến 90W mỗi cổng, PoE Power Budget 480 W
Thiết kế công nghiệp DIN-Rail vỏ kim loại chuẩn IP50, lắp DIN-Rail hoặc treo tường
Hỗ trợ nguồn DC dự phòng 48V~57V, chống sét lan truyền 6KV cho cổng RJ-45 downlink
Quản lý qua CLI/Web/SNMP; hỗ trợ TIP OpenLAN Switching (OLS), uCentral, OpenLAN cloudController

Network: SFP+ 10 Gigabit Uplink Ports (1000M/10G auto sensing)
IEEE 802.3x for full-duplex mode; Back-Pressure for half-duplex mode

IEEE 802.1D Spanning Tree Protocol (STP); IEEE 802.1w Rapid Spanning Tree Protocol (RSTP); IEEE 802.1s Multiple Spanning Tree Protocol (MSTP), 64 instances; BPDU Guard; BPDU filtering; Root Guard; BPDU transparent; Loopback detection; Non-Spanning Tree Loopback detection
Sub 50 msec convergence; Revertive operation mode; Multiple-ring network
Supports 4K VLAN; Port-based VLAN; IEEE 802.1Q VLAN; GVRP; IEEE 802.1v protocol-based VLAN; IP subnet-based VLAN; MAC-based VLAN; Traffic Segmentation
Q-in-Q; L2 protocol tunneling (xSTP, CDP, VTP and PVST+, LLDP); CDP/PVST+ filtering; Selective Q-in-Q
Static Trunk; IEEE 802.3ad Link Aggregation Control Protocol; Trunk Groups: 16, up to 8 GE/4 10G ports per group; Load Balancing: SA+DA, SA, DA, SIP+DIP, SIP, DIP
IGMP v1/v2/v3 Snooping; IGMP Proxy reporting; IGMP Filtering; IGMP Throttling; IGMP Immediate Leave; IGMP Querier

IEEE 802.1p CoS; IP Precedence; DSCP; MAC access control list (source/destination MAC, Ether type, priority ID/VLAN ID); IP standard access control list (source IP); IP extended access control list (source/destination IP, protocol, TCP/UDP port number)
Strict Priority; Weighted Round Robin; Strict +WRR
Ingress policy map (police rate, remark CoS); Egress policy map (police rate, remark CoS/DSCP)
Rate Limiting (ingress and egress, per port base)
GE: Resolution 64 Kbps ~1,000 Mbps; 10G: Resolution 64 Kbps ~10,000 Mbps

IPv4/IPv6 dual protocol stack; IPv6 Address Types Stack: Unicast; IPv6 Neighbor Discovery: Duplicate address, Address resolution, Unreachable neighbor detection; Stateless auto-configuration; Manual configuration; Remote IPv6 ping; IPv6 Telnet support; HTTP over IPv6; SNMP over IPv6; IPv6 Syslog support; IPv6 TFTP support; MLD Snooping v1/v2; IPv6 source guard; DHCPv6 snooping; MVR6
Power: 6pin removable terminal for DC Power in & Relay out
Physical: Thiết kế công nghiệp DIN-Rail vỏ kim loại chuẩn IP50
Est. 93mm x 127mm x 134mm (W x D x H)
Other: Port security; IEEE 802.1X port-based and MAC-based authentication; Dynamic VLAN Assignment, AutoQoS; MAC authentication; Web authentication; Voice VLAN; Guest VLAN; L2/L3/L4 access control list; IPv6 ACL; DHCP Snooping; DHCP Option 82; DHCP Option 82 Relay; IP Source Guard; PPPoE IA; Dynamic ARP Inspection; Denial of Service; Login security; RADIUS authentication; RADIUS accounting; TACACS +authentication; TACACS +accounting; TACACS +authorization; Management interface sccess filtering (SNMP, Web, Telnet); SSH (v2) for secure Telnet; SSL for HTTPS; SNMP v1/v2c/v3
CLI via console port or Telnet/SSH; Web management; SNMP v1, v2c,v3
Firmware upgrade via TFTP/HTTP/FTP/SFTPserver; Multiple configuration files; Configuration file upload/download viaTFTP/HTTP/FTP/SFTP server

RMON (groups 1, 2, 3 and 9); BOOTP, DHCP client for IP address assignment; DHCP dynamic provision option 66,67; SNTP; Syslog (local flash); Remotelog (RFC3164); SMTP (email notification); Support LLDP (802.1ab); sFlow v4,v5; Dying Gasp
Hỗ trợ TIP OpenLAN Switching (OLS), tích hợp uCentral và quản lý qua OpenLAN cloudController
Please check https://mk.com.vn/ for the warranty terms in your country.
